description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of topics within the $M^3EL$ dataset. The chart contains five slices, representing the categories “Movie”, “Person”, “Book”, “Sport”, and an unspecified fifth category. The “Movie” slice is light blue and occupies approximately 41.2% of the chart, while the “Person” slice is light pink and represents about 30.5%. The “Book” slice is light yellow and accounts for roughly 14.9%, and the “Sport” slice is light green, comprising approximately 9.1%. The remaining slice is dark gray and represents 4.3% of the total. A legend is present in the center of the chart, labeling each category with its corresponding color. Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, with the largest slices positioned first and decreasing in size as they proceed around the circle.
